newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain- Corn and soy steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain- Corn and soy steady.

text.p: U.S. Gulf FOB soybean and corn basis values were mostly steady amid lackluster dealings, export sources today.
News that India may be importing wheat rather than exporting and hopes for wheat business with Russia combined with short covering to boost CBOT wheat futures to a higher close, traders said.
There was also market talk in the U.S. soymeal market that China bought on Wednesday or Tuesday night 25,000 to 50,000 tonnes of U.S. soymeal for February shipment.
But details of the deal could not be confirmed.
